Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg

| 2026-02-15 | 28°C / 17°C | 15% | 14 km/h | **Picnic** |
| 2026-02-16 | 26°C / 16°C | 65% | 20 km/h | **Museum visit** |
| 2026-02-17 | 25°C / 15°C | 80% | 18 km/h | **Museum visit** |

# Weather Takeaway for Nairobi
